hook.text_role: an expert stops the viewer with a warning about something familiar
hook.visual: greenscreen: expert in front of a screenshot or clip, pointing

beats.visual: expert points at the background image, zoom-ins on details
background switches to the product, expert approves

beats.line_role: a person's last line, not a slogan: the brief's offer, else the product plus one dry line; never 'today', never the hook again

rules: roles and patterns only - no original lines, footage, audio or likeness
